statement: The Phase 0.3 locking-read policy has one exact machine/prose transition contract: every transition's owner, action semantics and outcome are mirrored in its architecture row; contention and abort identifiers are canonical and identical to typedOutcomes; localExpiry, reservationPersistence and multiParticipantConflict are explicitly verified; and the design-only proof fails closed if its comparison base is unavailable.

constraints.statement: Supersedes locking-read-wait-policy-seal-v2 after independent PR #91 review rejected its incomplete mirror probe, inconsistent contention identifier, and fail-open shallow path guard. Preserve the accepted fail-fast/no-wait/DTC-participant ownership design.
Every acquire/conflict/conflict_abort/timeout/cancellation/commit/rollback/crash/recovery row has one owner, action semantics and outcome verified against the corresponding architecture table row.
The conflict transition outcome equals typedOutcomes.contention exactly; conflict_abort equals typedOutcomes.abort exactly.
localExpiry, reservationPersistence and multiParticipantConflict are verified exact values, not prose-only claims.
The design-only changed-path guard uses a fetched comparison base and any git diff failure fails the job; no masking with || true around the diff command.
No transaction, SQL execution, PG wire, Raft, lifecycle, membership or formation production behavior changes in B1.
